name: auth
description: compusib auth toolchain for devcontainers. Implemented slices — m2m-certs: provisions jinja-template (compy wheel) and ssh-jwt (go.ptx.dk/ssh-jwt) via mise so the shared bash gen-jwt/gen-cert/trust mint machine-to-machine JWT credentials. pgtoken: a PostgreSQL client on libpq 18 or newer (psql) logs in over OAuth with a JWT that is given or with the ssh agent's key, no password and no browser. It installs a module of PostgreSQL 19's public libpq-oauth ABI, which libpq 19 loads by itself, and a loader that the remote user's ~/.bashrc.d preloads where libpq is 18. The connection's service names the issuer and the client; the feature sets no PG_OAUTH_* variable and installs no PostgreSQL client. Browser auth flows are a planned future slice. Requires a preinstalled mise; it does not install mise.

compyRepoPath.description: Path to the compusib/compy checkout. The jinja-template package is installed from <path>/apps/jinja-template into the mise-managed Python.

sshJwtVersion.description: Version of go.ptx.dk/ssh-jwt to build via mise's Go backend (go install go.ptx.dk/ssh-jwt/cmd/ssh-jwt@<version>). Accepts a tag (e.g. 'v0.0.6') or 'latest' (resolves to the newest published tag).

pythonVersion.description: Fallback Python to declare via mise (e.g. '3.13') ONLY if no mise Python is already active. Empty (default) never overrides an existing pin.

keepGoToolchain.description: Keep the Go mise tool after building ssh-jwt. Set false to run 'mise uninstall go' afterward (ssh-jwt keeps working; rebuilding it later needs Go again).
